# MenuPricesHub

> MenuPricesHub is a restaurant menu and price information website. Each restaurant page lists menu items with prices, photos, location, opening hours and FAQs. The site also covers food categories, restaurants by city, and blog guides about menu deals and nutrition.

Menu prices change often and may differ by location. Treat prices as a reference and confirm with the restaurant.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://menupriceshub.github.io/): Search restaurant menus, prices and calories
- [All Restaurants](https://menupriceshub.github.io/restaurants/): Browse every restaurant menu
- [Categories](https://menupriceshub.github.io/categories/): Browse by food type
- [Cities](https://menupriceshub.github.io/cities/): Find restaurants by city
- [Blog](https://menupriceshub.github.io/blog/): Guides on deals, comparisons and nutrition
- [FAQ](https://menupriceshub.github.io/faq/): Common questions
- [Calories and Nutrition](https://menupriceshub.github.io/calories-and-nutrition.html): Calories and nutrition information
- [Search](https://menupriceshub.github.io/search.html): Search restaurants and menu items
